title: NestedRoute
summary: A route module with explicit layout ownership.

sections.title: Shape
sections.body: Use absolute path patterns, a unique id, and parentId for layout nesting. index disambiguates index actions with ?index; pathless identifies grouping layouts that do not own an explicit action URL. Browser route modules can be lazy.
sections.code:
import type { NestedRoute } from "@kasperrt/smolter/preact/nested";
const route: NestedRoute = { id: "profile", parentId: "account", path: "/account/profile", lazy: () => import("./profile") };
